snippet.title: The First Descendant x EVANGELION Collaboration Trailer
snippet.description:
The First Descendant meets EVANGELION!
Iconic full-body skins of Rei, Asuka  and Mari, weapon skins, social motions, and more!
Experience all the charm of EVANGELION through a full-lineup of customization items. Coming June 18th!

🎮 PLAY FREE NOW: https://tfd.nexon.com/

The First Descendant is a free-to-play, third-person co-op action RPG shooter (looter shooter) powered by Unreal Engine 5. Featuring a diverse roster of unique characters, it offers both solo play and up to 8-player co-op where you can take on strategic boss battles. Experience the thrill of intense gunplay combined with the excitement of looting.
